limits: Triangle tests sample centroids and three edge midpoints in the declared static poses, plus vertices; they are not exhaustive continuous collision detection.
Inner and free-margin contact checks do not prove all outer-skin displacement, every triangle interior, all parameter extremes, or all devices are intersection-free.
Geometric shared-normal equality does not assert identical final fragment shading on both sides of every material boundary.
Browser rendering success and viewport simulation do not establish hardware frame rate or cinematic visual acceptance.
